newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian bonds, futures start out soft.
newsitem.headline: Italian bonds, futures start out soft.

text.p: 0740 GMT - Italian debt markets soft in early trade, lira steady vs mark and keeping dollar at bay just below 1,800 level reached yesterday. Treasury Minister Ciampi says sees no threat to inflation from dollar strength. Italian wage inflation 4.6 pct yr/yr in June, a fraction lower than May's 4.7 pct.
* Bonds:Feb07 -22bps at 102.48, yield at 6.49 pct, spread vs 10-yr Bund 95bps, well above recent record lows.
